rows.name: Stoneness
rows.description: Occulting bright light, eclipsed every 2 secs.

rows.name: Broadness
rows.description: Occulting light, bright 3 secs., eclipsed 7 secs.

rows.name: Northfleet
rows.character: One occulting bright or red light, ½ min.
rows.description: Red iron frame on India Arms wharf. Light eclipsed 3 secs. in every ½ minute. Bright in fairway of Northfleet Hope and Gravesend Reach; red over anchorage in Gravesend Reach and over Broadness

rows.name: Ovens Flat
rows.description: Gas-lighted buoy, showing an occulting light

rows.name: Mucking Flat
rows.character: One occulting bright or red light, ½ min.
rows.description: Red pile lt.-ho. Lt. red N. of E. by S. ½ S. over Scar Elbow, and a narrow red ray to S. ½ E. over W. Blyth buoy. Red W. of S.W. ¾ W. over Ovens Spit. Bright elsewhere. Eclipsed 3 secs. in every ½ min.

rows.name: Chapman Head
rows.character: One occulting bright or red light, ½ min.
rows.description: Red pile lt.-house. Light is bright in fairway channel; red over Leigh Middle to North of S.E. by E. ¾ E. Light eclipsed for 3 secs. twice in quick succession in every ½ minute

rows.name: Sheerness
rows.description: Gas light on N.W. face of circular fort on Garrison Point. Not visible North of N.N.W. Gas-lighted buoys, each showing an occulting light, are placed at East Oaze Sand, and Sheerness Middle Ground

rows.name: Queenborough
rows.description: 1. Two red leading lts. on pier, in line S. 7° W. 2. A bright light is shown from beacon on extr. of Queenborough Spit, in 6 ft. water

rows.name: NORE LIGHTVESSEL
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In 4 fathoms, at East end of the Nore Sand. Painted red, with ball at mast-head

rows.name: Girdler Lightvessel
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In 3½ fathoms, West Girdler Sand, at West entrance of Princes Channel. Red, with ball

rows.name: Princes Channel Lt.-Ves.
rows.description: In 4 fms., North side of channel, betw. Girdler and Tongue lightvessels. Red, with ball

rows.name: Tongue Lightvessel
rows.description: In 10 fms., North side of East Tongue Sand. Red, with ball. Lt. gives one red flash and one bright flash in quick succession every ½ min.

rows.name: Margate Pier
rows.description: Column, 70 ft. high, at West end of pier. Also a small green light on end of jetty

rows.name: Mouse Lightvessel
rows.description: In 4 fathoms, at West end of Sand. Red, with ball

rows.name: Maplin Pile Lighthouse
rows.character: One occulting red light, ½ minute
rows.description: Painted red. Lt. eclipsed 3 secs. in ev. ½ min., not vis. over the sand; a bright ray to S. ¾ W. betw. Girdler light and Shivering Sand buoy. Bright lt. shown 13 ft. below main lt. to S.E. by E. ¾ E. over Spit buoy Maplin Spit Buoy carries an occulting bright gas light

rows.name: Swin Middle Lightvessel
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In 5½ fathoms, at West end of Sand. Red, with ball
